name: sub2api-scripting-monitor
description: Sub2API iOS Scripting 被动监控与手动确认重置

scripts.typecheck:core: tsc --strict --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --noEmit model.ts client.ts operations.ts display.ts provider-images.ts provider-artwork.ts
scripts.check:render: node tests/check-render.cjs && node tests/check-intent.cjs && node tests/check-widget-network.cjs && node tests/check-connection-panel.cjs && node tests/check-setup-status.cjs
